### PR.DS-01.3 {#pr-ds-01-3}

### PR.DS-01.5 {#pr-ds-01-5}

## 6.3.4 PR.DS-11 Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested

[Read section 6.3.4 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-p-02#s-6-3-4)

### PR.DS-11.1 {#pr-ds-11-1}

Backups for the organisation's business-critical data shall be performed and stored on a different system from the device on which the original data resides.

### PR.DS-11.3 {#pr-ds-11-3}

The organisation shall maintain secure backups of business-critical data in a separate storage location to ensure data availability in case of system failure or data loss. Backup storage shall apply equivalent security controls as the primary environment.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 114](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=114)

### PR.DS-11.4 {#pr-ds-11-4}

Backup testing shall be integrated into broader resilience planning, including business continuity, disaster recovery, and cyber incident response.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 115](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=115)

- **Group:** PR.DS-11 Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested



### PR.DS-11.5 {#pr-ds-11-5}

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 115](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=115)

- **Group:** PR.DS-11 Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested

## 6.5.1 PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage

[Read section 6.5.1 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-p-02#s-6-5-1)

### PR.IR-01.1 {#pr-ir-01-1}

Firewalls shall be installed, configured, and actively maintained on all networks used by the organisation to protect against unauthorised access and cyber threats.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 127](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=127)

- **Group:** PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage



### PR.IR-01.2 {#pr-ir-01-2}

To safeguard critical systems, organisations shall implement network segmentation and segregation aligned with trust boundaries and asset criticality, thereby limiting threat propagation and enforcing strict access control

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 128](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=128)

- **Group:** PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage



### PR.IR-01.3 {#pr-ir-01-3}

To ensure operational stability and security, the organisation shall, without exception, identify, document, and control connections between components of its critical systems.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 128](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=128)

- **Group:** PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage



### PR.IR-01.4 {#pr-ir-01-4}

The organisation shall implement appropriate boundary protection measures to monitor and control communications at external and key internal boundaries of its critical systems, across both IT and OT environments, to ensure secure and reliable operations.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 129](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=129)

- **Group:** PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage



### PR.IR-01.5 {#pr-ir-01-5}

The organisation shall implement, where feasible, authenticated proxy servers or firewalls with URL filtering and threat intelligence capabilities for defined communications traffic between its critical systems and external networks.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 130](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=130)

- **Group:** PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage



### PR.IR-01.6 {#pr-ir-01-6}

The organisation shall ensure that its critical systems are designed to fail securely and remain protected in the event of an operational failure of a border protection device.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 131](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=131)

- **Group:** PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage



### PR.IR-01.7 {#pr-ir-01-7}

The organisation shall ensure that development and test environments are strictly separated from the production environment, particularly in ICS/OT systems where any crossover could compromise safety, endanger health, or disrupt essential operations.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 132](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=132)

- **Group:** PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage



### PR.IR-01.8 {#pr-ir-01-8}

The organisation shall define, monitor, and control the flow of information and data within and between its critical systems to ensure that only authorised and secure exchanges occur, regardless of network boundaries or system architecture.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 133](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=133)

- **Group:** PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage



### PR.IR-01.9 {#pr-ir-01-9}

The organisation shall manage interfaces with external telecommunications services as part of its broader network security policy, by defining how traffic is controlled, ensuring the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information, and reviewing and documenting any exceptions to established rules.

**Control** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 134](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-02_Essential_Entity_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=134)

- **Group:** PR.IR-01 Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage
